next_focus_options.title: Give an update people can follow
next_focus_options.reason: Practice structure: Give a three-part update: where things stand, what's at risk, and what you need.

next_focus_options.title: Handle pushback calmly
next_focus_options.reason: Practice persuasion: When challenged, acknowledge the concern, answer it with one specific fact, then restate your ask.

next_focus_options.title: Bring others in
next_focus_options.reason: Practice listening: After you speak, ask one specific question and build on the answer before adding your view.
